modes.observe: Log risky actions but allow them.
modes.confirm: Ask before risky desktop, file deletion, and destructive shell actions.
modes.block: Block risky actions automatically. Recommended for smoke tests.

notes: The runtime guard is activated by environment variable, not by storing secrets or machine-specific state in Git.
Use scripts/jarvis-mark-xl/start-safe.ps1 to launch Mark-XL with the guard enabled.
The first safety scope is file deletion, risky subprocess commands, and PyAutoGUI desktop interaction calls. Future phases can add UI approval prompts and per-tool allowlists.
